pages.useWhen: never alone past a few dozen pages: today’s first pages, then read page by page
pages.avoidWhen: a file is longer than the brain’s share of context
knownLimits: scanned PDFs, with no text layer, are not read
Arabic letters some fonts draw as ligatures can come back from PDFs in the wrong order

lexical.useWhen: names, codes, numbers, dates, terms the files use; any size, any language the query is written in
lexical.avoidWhen: the question’s words aren’t the files’ (a paraphrase, another language) and the brain can’t rewrite them
needs: an index made once per file
knownLimits: scanned PDFs, with no text layer, are not read
Arabic letters some fonts draw as ligatures can come back from PDFs in the wrong order

exact.useWhen: every place a code or phrase is: counting, the latest of several versions, totals over rows
knownLimits: scanned PDFs, with no text layer, are not read
Arabic letters some fonts draw as ligatures can come back from PDFs in the wrong order

lexical+exact.useWhen: a question naming a code: its places first, then the best passages
needs: an index made once per file
knownLimits: scanned PDFs, with no text layer, are not read
Arabic letters some fonts draw as ligatures can come back from PDFs in the wrong order

preselect.useWhen: a brain whose context can’t hold the file (the device’s 32k): the matching pages instead of the first
preselect.avoidWhen: the brain can call tools well and has room
needs: an index made once per file
knownLimits: scanned PDFs, with no text layer, are not read
